# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository contains public documentation and early project specifications. It is not currently a production civic platform.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not publish exploitable vulnerabilities, credentials, personal data or sensitive operational details in a public issue.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature if it is enabled for this repository. Otherwise contact the repository owner through GitHub's private contact mechanism and share only the minimum information needed to reproduce the issue.

Do not test against systems you do not own or have explicit permission to assess. Do not access, modify or disclose other people's data.

## Sensitive environments

Do not submit identifying information about people involved in political or civic activity, especially where disclosure could expose them to retaliation. Do not upload secrets, access tokens, private keys, passwords or private participant lists.

## Response

The project will acknowledge reports when practicable, assess severity and impact, coordinate a fix and publish an advisory when disclosure is safe. No response-time guarantee is made at this early stage.

## Deployment rule

Any future feature that processes personal or sensitive data requires documented threat modelling, data minimisation, security review and an accountable incident-response plan before deployment.
